{{Quote|Once we realised you had to be nearby in order to use your short-range control unit, we simply drove around until we found a portable container ''large enough'' to house you!|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="The Runaway Ride" />}}
This '''vehicle''' was used by [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]] on [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin]] during his [[Ambush of the Goldskin Parade|ambush]] of the [[Goldskin Parade]]. It featured a [[Rectenna/Legends|rectenna]] and was used as a mobile command vehicle during the operation. Gorga used this vehicle to [[Shortwave remote control hack|remotely control]] a [[Separatist Heavy Speeder]] which had been recently captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] after the [[Liberation of Nothoiin|liberation]] of Nothoiin. During the ambush, Gorga's vehicle was rammed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] Heavy Speeder and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] was arrested.
